verdict.rationale: Sunbiz's own pages list online filing for LLC Articles of Organization and Profit/Non-Profit Articles of Incorporation. Annual reports can be filed online and paid by credit card, debit card, or a prepaid E-File account, and are processed and posted immediately. That covers the form, file, and pay elements of the story from first-party pages; the robots.txt probe concerns crawler access only and does not contradict the filing capability. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent corroboration of completing a formation filing end-to-end on the e-filing host.
